mission.communityDriven: Diverse Ethereum builders in Korea share their insights and research. Anyone can become a contributor, and the community builds it together.

mission.tickerEth: ECK's Telegram channel initiative — delivering daily Ethereum insights to Korean builders.
mission.ethereumKorea: A community hub where builders, researchers, and contributors of Korea's Ethereum ecosystem meet and collaborate.
mission.newsletter: A weekly digest of Ethereum protocol, L2, and EIP developments — delivered straight to your inbox.

tools.etherscan: Ethereum mainnet block explorer and analytics platform
tools.beaconchain: Beacon chain validator and staking dashboard

tools.curve: DEX specialized in stablecoins and pegged assets

tools.l2beat: L2 rollup risk analysis and TVL tracking
tools.ultrasound: Real-time ETH issuance, burn, and supply dashboard
tools.ethereumAdoption: Database tracking enterprise and institutional Ethereum adoption
tools.hardhat: Ethereum dev environment — test, deploy, debug
tools.foundry: Rust-based high-speed smart contract development toolkit
tools.remix: Browser-based Solidity IDE — instant compile and deploy
tools.tenderly: Smart contract debugging, simulation, and monitoring
tools.ethereumMagicians: Ethereum governance forum — EIP discussions and community proposals
tools.etherealize: Infrastructure and tools project to improve Ethereum ecosystem accessibility
tools.ethereumPm: Ethereum core developer meeting agendas and protocol upgrade tracker
